intro: George Town rewards visitors with UNESCO streets, hawker feasts and island escapes. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: No metro or tram on Penang Island; buses do the work.
Rapid Penang buses fan out from Weld Quay via KOMTAR; fares RM1.40-4.
Free CAT buses loop the heritage core and modern centre.
Grab is the main ride app; taxis use coupon or meter.
Rapid Ferry links Butterworth rail station to Weld Quay, RM1.20.
The heritage core is compact and walkable; Link Bike day pass RM6.

unesco_zone.name: George Town UNESCO Zone
unesco_zone.tip: Start at the waterfront and wander the grid of streets on foot; most heritage sights sit within 20 minutes of each other.

fort_cornwallis.name: Fort Cornwallis
fort_cornwallis.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
fort_cornwallis.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–18:00; check on the day
fort_cornwallis.tip: Climb the ramparts for harbour views and look for the old bronze cannon.

khoo_kongsi.name: Khoo Kongsi
khoo_kongsi.price_text: Modest entry fee; check on the day
khoo_kongsi.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–17:00; check on the day
khoo_kongsi.tip: Look up at the carved roof and painted beams; the clan house courtyard is the highlight.

peranakan_mansion.name: Pinang Peranakan Mansion
peranakan_mansion.price_text: Entry fee; check on the day
peranakan_mansion.hours: Daily, roughly 09:30–17:00; check on the day
peranakan_mansion.tip: Allow an hour; the furnished rooms and antiques give the best sense of Peranakan home life.

clan_jetties.name: Clan Jetties
clan_jetties.price_text: Free to walk; some houses ask a small donation
clan_jetties.tip: These are lived-in homes, so keep quiet and ask before taking photos.

kek_lok_si.name: Kek Lok Si Temple
kek_lok_si.price_text: Grounds free; small fees for some halls and the incline lift
kek_lok_si.hours: Daily, roughly 08:30–17:30; check on the day
kek_lok_si.tip: It sits on a hill outside the centre, so take a taxi or bus and allow half a day.

batu_ferringhi.name: Batu Ferringhi
batu_ferringhi.hours: Always open; night market in the evening
batu_ferringhi.tip: The sea is warm and the sand is busy; come for sunset and the evening night market.

penang_hill.name: Penang Hill
penang_hill.price_text: Funicular ticket; check on the day
penang_hill.hours: Daily, roughly 06:30–23:00; check on the day
penang_hill.tip: Go early or late to skip queues; the air is cooler at the top.

chowrasta_market.name: Chowrasta Market
chowrasta_market.price_text: Free to browse; food priced per item
chowrasta_market.hours: Morning to early afternoon; busiest early
chowrasta_market.tip: Come before 10:00 for the freshest produce and local breakfast stalls.

hawker_food_tour.name: Hawker food walk
hawker_food_tour.price_text: Guided tours vary; self-guided is cheap
hawker_food_tour.hours: Evening is best for street food
hawker_food_tour.tip: Try char kway teow, laksa and cendol; pick stalls with long local queues.

street_art_walk.name: Street art walk
street_art_walk.tip: Go early to photograph the murals before crowds and heat arrive.

gurney_drive.name: Gurney Drive hawker centre
gurney_drive.tip: Come hungry and share dishes; the seafront promenade is good for a stroll after.

chew_jetty.name: Chew Jetty
chew_jetty.price_text: Free; small fees for some boardwalks
chew_jetty.tip: The most visitor-friendly jetty; walk the boardwalk and buy a snack from a resident stall.

tropical_spice_garden.name: Tropical Spice Garden
tropical_spice_garden.price_text: Entry fee; check on the day
tropical_spice_garden.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–18:00; check on the day
tropical_spice_garden.tip: A shaded walk near Batu Ferringhi; good for a break from the beach.

trishaw_ride.name: Trishaw ride through heritage streets
trishaw_ride.tip: Agree the price and route first; a short loop is enough to see the main streets.

armenia_street.name: Armenian Street walk
armenia_street.tip: A short street packed with shophouses, murals and cafes; combine it with nearby clan houses.

penang_museum.name: Penang State Museum
penang_museum.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
penang_museum.hours: Closed some days; check on the day
penang_museum.tip: Good background on Penang's history before you explore the streets.

batu_night_market.name: Batu Ferringhi night market
batu_night_market.tip: Bargain politely and try local snacks; it runs along the main beach road.

esplanade_viewpoint.name: Esplanade seafront promenade
esplanade_viewpoint.tip: A breezy waterfront walk near the fort; good for sunset views over the strait.

ferry_ride.name: Penang ferry crossing
ferry_ride.price_text: Low fare; check on the day
ferry_ride.tip: A cheap way to see the harbour and mainland skyline; check the current route and times.

little_india.name: Little India walk
little_india.tip: Follow the smell of spices and try a banana-leaf meal or fresh sweets.

botanic_gardens.name: Penang Botanic Gardens
botanic_gardens.hours: Daily, early to evening; check on the day
botanic_gardens.tip: Quiet shaded paths and monkeys; go early for cooler air.

cooking_class.name: Nyonya cooking class
cooking_class.tip: Learn a few Peranakan dishes and eat what you cook; confirm the menu and price when booking.

sunset_cruise.name: Sunset harbour cruise
sunset_cruise.price_text: Tours vary; check on the day
sunset_cruise.tip: A relaxed way to see the waterfront; confirm departure point and weather policy.

plans.for: One full day of eating your way through George Town, from breakfast stalls to a late hawker dinner.

stays.why: Walk to the murals, clan houses and hawker food. Best for first-timers without a car.
Seafront promenade and the famous hawker centre; short ride to the heritage core.
Quieter local area with cafés and malls; between the city and the beaches.
Beach resorts and night market; far from town, so plan on buses or Grab.

food: Eat at hawker centres: char kway teow, laksa, and cendol. Expect roughly RM5–15 a dish; check prices on the day.
Kopitiam breakfast: kaya toast, half-boiled eggs and local coffee. Cheap and quick.
Peranakan (Nyonya) dishes are the local signature: try a set meal in a heritage shophouse.
Gurney Drive hawker centre is busy at night; go early for a seat.
Little India and Chinatown lanes are good for cheap eats. Many stalls close on one weekday; check on the day.
more_time: Penang Hill: take the funicular for cooler air and views. Go early to beat queues.
Kek Lok Si temple in Air Itam is a half-day trip; combine with a laksa lunch nearby.
Beach time at Batu Ferringhi, or a day trip to the national park and beaches on the north coast.
